sourceDifferenceJudgement.training: Only documented run paths, review switches/notes and whitespace changed from the template.
sourceDifferenceJudgement.threshold: Only documented run path/review switches/notes plus a developer preview changed.
sourceDifferenceJudgement.developerPreview: Cell 22 imports random, uses mango_test, and selects random.randrange(0,300). It runs after frozen evaluation, does not change saved metrics, and omits the last 93 test rows from its random preview range.

limits: All mango and OOD report collections are historically reused; this is exploratory evidence.
The same validation set selects training checkpoints, fits temperature, and constrains gate selection. Calibration/validation figures are fitting diagnostics, not independent accuracy estimates.
The 95% target constrains aggregate accepted validation images, including accepted wrong diagnoses; no per-class retention or accepted-error constraint is imposed.
Old OOD tune and report halves contain 84 images each; the report-only reused new collection contains just 32 images.
No saved ECE metric was present; no new calibration statistic or inference was added.
No expert-labeled mango field evaluation or actual TensorFlow.js browser parity was measured.

candidateJudgement.primary: V4.3.0 is arithmetically valid but does not demonstrate superiority to active V4.1.1 Background or matched V4.1.1 Combined.
candidateJudgement.mango: All selected mango returned decisions are identical; raw test classification loses one previously correct rejected bacterial-black-spot image.
candidateJudgement.oldOod: Six previously accepted images become rejected and four rejected images become accepted, for two fewer false accepts overall.
candidateJudgement.reusedNewOod: Four previously rejected images become accepted; the prior single false accept remains accepted, increasing false accepts from 1/32 to 5/32.

frozenProbabilityGateCounterfactuals.note: Derived diagnostic using already saved V430 probabilities with historical entropy gates; no weights, selected candidate, or thresholds were changed. Historical gates are infeasible if validation accepted is below 372.
